svg.title: ARCHANGEL
svg.desc: A 16-color boot screen with a pixel drawing of an A-12 spy plane, listing what the agent reads, its approval and dry-run gates, and what it refuses to do.
svg.text: FINDS THE ROLES. TAILORS THE RESUME.
PREPARES THE FORM. YOU APPROVE IT.
RUNS ON YOUR COMPUTER. YOUR DATA STAYS THERE.

g.text: ARCHANGEL BOOT // INTERNSHIP SEARCH AGENT FOR CLAUDE CODE
profile.toml ........ the only facts it may enter on a form
facts.toml .......... resume bullets, in your own words
76 starter job boards + GitHub lists + alert emails
require_approval = true ... nothing goes out unless you say so
dry_run = true ............ stops before Submit on a new install
LinkedIn automation / CAPTCHAs / passwords / invented facts
dashboard bound to 127.0.0.1 ... your data stays on this computer
